snippet.title: Aliens Online (1998) - Alien Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
The official 30 second gameplay teaser from Mythic Entertainment.

Multiplay gameplay video footage of Aliens Online is impossible to capture any longer, since the servers were shut down in 2000. These two videos are, to my knowledge, the only of their kind.
